perk.name: Broad Investments
perk.notes: Magda has actually amassed a vastly larger (i.e. 15-point level) level of investments, derived in part from her ability to locate and extract minerals (particularly high-value ones like platinum, lithium, cobalt, and neodymium) directly. These are, however, /investments/, and she can generally access only a comparatively small portion of her wealth without gutting it or wrecking other programs, ongoing donations to charity, and various endowments she has in motion. Levels in Wealth will be bought up as XP presents itself.

perk.input: Charities, Donations, Endowments, Etc. and People Met Through Them
perk.notes: Due to the large portfolio of her regular donations, charitable trusts, bequests, endowments, contributions, scholarships, so on and so forth, Magda is on the donor's list of a great number of organizations, and receives invitations to charity dinners and the like on a weekly, if not daily, basis. While she does not go to the vast majority of them, her donations and charitable trusts remain a foot in the door, and she can often gain behind-the-scenes access to non-sensitive places (schools, museums, performing arts venues, and the like) with relatively little effort. It also allows her to make contact with other individuals, whether wealthy, powerful, or both, who are often found at such places.

disad.notes: M is the human equivalent of a stellar body -- she is almost always emitting a unique radio-wave signature due to her constant low-level subconscious use of her powers. As a consequence, any individual with access to Radio-group senses (particularly Radar) will find it easier (+2 to their PER Roll) to locate her or the vehicle she's in. This can be suppressed (i.e. concealed via Invisibility), but it takes focus to do so, and infringes upon her other capabilities.

disad.notes: Magda is technically a mutant.  However, she has the (unspecified) ability to suppress the genetic signature of being so; as a consequence, it requires direct and in-depth examination of her DNA in order to discover this for certain.

disad.input: Soldiers Die, Cancer Must Be Cut Out
disad.notes: M is, perhaps unfortunately, not entirely Truly Heroic; while she rarely kills, she can understand the necessity -- sometimes without hesitation, without remorse.  She was never a casual and conscienceless killer; she simply understands, both as a person and as a physician, that in battle, soldiers die, that sometimes a few must be sacrificed in order to save millions, and that some people cannot be saved nor should one risk their possible freedom.  However, unless there is no other way -- and as a person of great knowledge and fair power, she knows /lots/ of possibilities -- she will seek another method to deal with the problem.  She is not without compassion or mercy -- but she is a realist, and knows that the sort of compassion needed sometimes is swift and final oblivion.

Abuse of power -- slavery, intentional murder, corruption, abuse (whether physical, psychological, or sexual), even just bog-standard bullying -- is something that has always severely offended Magda, and she will almost always intervene in some manner.  M has ignored borders, military power, death threats, and what some wits described as 'political reality' in pursuit of interfering with ongoing situations.  On the smaller scale, such as in a school situation, while she will step in to stop it, she will /also/ work to empower the bullied -- both psychologically and physically.

With great wealth and power comes the responsibility to use it for the greater good -- which is to say, help those without to improve their situation.  But do it on your own terms, and in your own way.
With wealth, knowledge, and a turbulent past, Magda's identity and location being publically known will undoubtedly draw attention, ire, and possibly literal fire.
